text: {"lessons":["I should diversify across stocks rather than rely on a few positions; I have holdings in A, C, E, and now B, but should keep position sizes deliberate.","Selling part of A and E locked in gains, but a short run of returns does not prove I can time the market; I should make trades based on a plan, not recent price moves.","I’m investing toward an apartment within ten years, so I should balance growth with the cash I may need and avoid trading just because I check my account often."]}
